title: scroll context
body: When connecting to an Ubuntu server via SSH and running Claude inside a tmux session, there is no scroll context available — I can’t scroll up or down with my finger. Outside tmux (running the same command directly), scrolling works perfectly. Please fix scroll behavior inside tmux sessions — this is important for working with interactive CLI tools like Claude or chat-based interfaces.
